title: Treap
description: Write a Zig program that implements a Treap (tree + heap) data structure with randomized priorities.
hints: A Treap combines a binary search tree with a heap using random priorities
Rotations maintain both BST and heap properties
The highest-priority node should end up at the root

steps.title: Set up the Treap project

hints: Create the main source file for Treap
Set up the basic program structure

verification.failureMessage: Initialize the project with proper structure.

steps.title: Implement the core logic for Treap
steps.description: Write the main algorithm or core functionality that drives this project. Break down the problem into smaller functions for clarity.
hints: Start with the simplest part of the algorithm
Test each function as you write it
Use descriptive variable and function names
